description: EXPERIMENTAL (r32, only 29 weekends of history): HL xyz single-stock/index perps trade 24/7; Monday reverses ~half of the weekend move cross-sectionally. Sunday 23:00 UTC: long the weekend losers, short the winners, weights ∝ −(weekend move − mean), ≤10%/name, gross 1; exit at Monday's US close.
name: xyz_weekend_fade
